entities.summary: Matryona Semyonovna Nazdracheva, née Necheporchukova was a combat medic in Red Army who rescued 250 wounded soldiers and officers during World War II. On 15 May 1946 she was awarded the Order of Glory 1st Class and became one of only four women to receive all three classes of that order.
